Operations consulting for mid-market manufacturers

Northgate Advisory is a consulting firm built for mid-market manufacturing companies with 50 to 500 employees. We help owners and management teams fix throughput, protect margin and integrate acquisitions, and we stay until the numbers move.

Book a consultation See our services

What we do

  • Operations strategy — a 90-day diagnostic of plant, supply chain and planning, with a costed roadmap.
  • Margin improvement — product-line profitability, procurement and waste, typically 3 to 6 points of gross margin.
  • Post-merger integration — one operating model, one ERP, one sales team, in the first 100 days.

Who we work with

Family-owned and private-equity-backed manufacturers across the United States and Canada: metal fabrication, food processing, packaging, building products and industrial components.
